name: senior-mjs-both-65-phaseout
description: Married filing jointly, both spouses 65+, MAGI $200,000: each spouse's $6,000 enhanced deduction is independently reduced by 6% of the $50,000 over the $150,000 MFJ threshold (per-person $3,000, total $6,000), added to the 2 x $1,600 65+ additional standard deduction.

source.publication: Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part V lines 31-37 (lines 36a/36b are entered per person); Instructions for Form 1040 (2025)
source.pin: Part V worksheet: line 32 = '$150,000 if married filing jointly'; line 34 = 6% of the excess; line 35 = $6,000 minus line 34; lines 36a and 36b each take line 35 (one per eligible spouse); line 37 adds them. Instructions: 'If you are married filing jointly, and both you and your spouse were born before January 2, 1961... the maximum amount... is $12,000.'

derivation: NIIT $0 (MAGI under the $250,000 MFJ threshold). Total tax $24,874.00.
